content:
The **Brotherhood's Emergency Radio** is an unused, quest-specific radio station that would have been broadcasted in Appalachia.

**Scribe Grant**: Station 14123 Dash R. Cluster detected in 13.4 kHz band. Report immediately to station chief... TAGGERDY or GRANT. Threat level: Critical. Code word: Spyglass. Repeat: Spyglass. This is, uh, not a drill. Automated sensors are picking up a mass of Scorched. Report to Defiance forward defense. If, uh, you're receiving this the Officer of the Watch isn't available. Emergency. Emergency.
